business_scope.primary_industry_name: Security Holographic Cold Foil Printing of Collectible Trading Cards

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (US-derived common-law corporate statutes, RMI Constitution, and customary law; Business Corporations Act is modeled on Delaware and New York corporate law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No comprehensive bilateral investment treaty or double taxation agreement currently registered for the Republic of the Marshall Islands.
United States-Republic of the Marshall Islands Compact of Free Association (1986, as amended 2003) is the principal bilateral treaty affecting trade, investment and economic assistance.
Pacific Island Countries Trade Agreement (PICTA) regional trade framework applies to the RMI.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) AML/CFT Act 2018, as amended; RMI Financial Intelligence Unit Directives on Customer Due Diligence and Beneficial Ownership; Business Corporations Act (BCA) 1990, as amended, provisions relating to shareholder records and registered agents; RMI Beneficial Ownership Reporting Regulations and FATCA/CRS information-sharing decrees.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access — beneficial ownership data is held by the licensed registered agent and made available to the Registrar of Corporations, the Financial Intelligence Unit, and tax/AML authorities upon lawful request; it is not publicly searchable.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Internal corporate compliance form; notarized if executed outside the RMI

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based CDD before incorporation; each director, shareholder, UBO, and signatory must be screened against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the U.S. OFAC SDN and non-SDN lists, UK/HM Treasury sanctions where applicable, EU sanctions where applicable, and RMI domestic AML/CFT warning lists. PEPs must receive Enhanced Due Diligence, source-of-wealth review, senior management approval, and ongoing transaction monitoring. Any positive hit requires immediate Suspicious Activity Report filing with the RMI FIU and a refusal of the proposed incorporation until clearance.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Republic of the Marshall Islands Office of the Registrar of Corporations — Corporate Registry e-Filing and Name Clearance Portal (filings accepted through licensed RMI registered agents using the statutory RMI registry forms)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be in Roman/Latin script; English and Marshallese characters are accepted. Foreign-language names must be transliterated into Latin script in the Articles of Incorporation. Each business corporation name must contain a corporate designator such as Corporation, Incorporated, Company, Limited, or an approved abbreviation (Corp., Inc., Co., Ltd.). Names must not be misleading, identical, or confusingly similar to an existing registered name in the RMI registry.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation may be renewed once for an additional 30 days if no intervening identical name has been filed. On rejection, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of Corporations within 14 days of the notice, amending the name to remove the prohibited or confusing token. If the Registrar maintains the refusal, the applicant may seek judicial review in the High Court of the Marshall Islands within 30 days of the final administrative decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted for a non-resident collectible trading card publisher. The statutory requirement is a physical registered office in the RMI at the address of a licensed registered agent; a virtual or remote office may be used for the company's actual publishing/e-commerce operations, but it cannot replace the statutory RMI registered office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: baseline unannounced inspection probability is approximately 5–10% per annum for this low-risk ISIC 3240 publishing activity; the probability may rise to 15–25% if a UBO, director, or counterparty is a PEP or triggers sanctions/AML alerts.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (Title 51, RMI Revised Code), principally Sections 29-33 (Articles of Incorporation), Section 34 (Certificate of Incorporation), Sections 41-44 (registered office and agent), and Part VIII (directors and officers).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Commerce and Trade, Republic of the Marshall Islands; all filings are effected through licensed RMI registered agents.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation, endorsed with a Certificate of Incorporation issued by the Registrar of Corporations.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; the Business Corporations Act permits a nominal authorized capital, shares may be issued with or without par value, and no escrow or deposit of capital in a Marshall Islands bank account is required for a non-resident business corporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscription and allotment of 1,000 shares of Common Stock, par value US$1.00 per share, to the founding subscriber be and hereby is approved, such shares to be fully paid in cash prior to issuance; RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Corporation in the Republic of the Marshall Islands be and is hereby fixed at the office of the Corporation's licensed registered agent, whose appointment is ratified in all respects; RESOLVED, that the Bylaws submitted to this meeting are adopted as the Bylaws of the Corporation; RESOLVED, that [President], [Secretary], and [Treasurer] are appointed as the initial officers, each to serve until successors are duly elected; RESOLVED, that the officers are authorized to open bank accounts, execute commercial agreements, and conduct all ordinary business of the Corporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Availability Clearance and Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, via a licensed Marshall Islands registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a written name reservation request to the licensed registered agent, who will query the Registrar's domestic and foreign corporate index. Select a name that is distinguishable from existing registered names and complies with the statutory corporate name suffixes. Reserve the approved name for a 60-day period.
required_dossiers: Statement of proposed corporate business purpose
Identification of incorporator and registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused as confusingly similar, file an amended reservation with two alternative names; if the name is objectionable for statutory reasons, adopt a revised name and re-submit, paying only the incremental reservation fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed RMI registered agent, with notarization by a recognized notary public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation in accordance with Title 51, including the corporate name, registered agent name and physical RMI street address, authorized share structure, permitted purpose clauses covering printing, publishing and sale of collectible trading cards, and the incorporator's name and address. The incorporator must execute the Articles, with signature notarized, and the registered agent must execute its written consent to act.
required_dossiers: Written consent of the registered agent
Evidence of registered office street address in the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a deficiency notice regarding the Articles, file a curative amendment or restated Articles within 15 days; correct jurisdictional or purpose clause language and re-execute signatures.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Articles with the Registrar and Payment of Government Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent submits the executed Articles of Incorporation, registered agent consent, and the government filing fee of USD 275 to the Registrar. Fees are remitted by wire or through the agent's escrow account. The application is date-stamped and assigned a file reference number.
required_dossiers: Executed Articles of Incorporation (original plus one copy)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If filing is rejected for formal defects, the registered agent will re-file within 10 days after correction at no additional government fee; if the fee schedule was misapplied, submit the difference with an explanatory note.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Commencement of Corporate Existence
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory review, the Registrar endorses the Articles and issues the Certificate of Incorporation, which conclusively evidences the creation of the BC. The effective date is stated on the certificate; if backdating is required, request a specified effective date within 90 days prior to filing.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate is withheld, the agent will obtain a written statement of grounds and submit a revised application; if the Registrar refuses to act, a petition may be made to the High Court for mandamus under the RMI Rules of Civil Procedure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Confirmation of Registered Agent and Registered Office; Initial Franchise Tax Compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed RMI registered agency and the Registrar of Corporations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute a registered agent services agreement confirming the registered office address in the Marshall Islands. Complete the annual franchise tax statement based on authorized shares and ensure the initial franchise tax is paid before the corporation transacts business; maintain the registered agent's annual certification of good standing.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the franchise tax is underpaid, file an amended statement and pay the balance with interest; if the registered agent resigns, appoint a successor agent within 30 days to avoid administrative dissolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Organizational Meeting and Adoption of Corporate Governance Instruments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors acting by unanimous written consent in lieu of a physical meeting
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The incorporator or initial directors convene the organizational meeting, by written consent or teleconference, to adopt Bylaws, approve the share subscription agreement, ratify the registered agent and office, elect officers, and approve banking resolutions for payment processors (Stripe and Authorize.Net). Minutes are executed by the Secretary.
required_dossiers: Share subscription agreement and share certificate stubs
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an organizational act is later challenged for lack of formality, ratify by a unanimous written consent executed by all directors/members with retroactive effect under Title 51.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Foreign Investment Board, Ministry of Commerce and Trade, Republic of the Marshall Islands
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Foreign Investment Business License (FIBL) under the Foreign Investment Business Act 2003; conditionally required only if a physical printing facility is established in RMI territory, with non-resident trading-card publishing exempt from any statutory operating license.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Republic of the Marshall Islands Environmental Protection Authority (RMI EPA), Majuro
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B - Preliminary Environmental Assessment (PEA)/Registration; a full EIA Report is required only for large-scale production plants exceeding de minimis output thresholds, packaging ink throughput, or wastewater discharge volumes.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero liquid discharge of process wastewater to coastal waters; volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions limited to 50 mg C/m3 for printing and curing lines; compliance with RMI EPA Marine Water Quality Standards; mandatory hazardous waste manifesting for spent inks, solvents, and silver-bearing toner under Basel Convention controls; solid foil and paper trim to certified recycling facilities.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Majuro local government fire marshal; structural load inspection certificate for any production facility; electrical installation clearance; and RMI workplace health clearance covering material safety data sheets, personal protective equipment, and ventilation controls for cold-foil holographic printing operations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance, Treasury and Accounting of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (Revenue and Taxation Division); no public e-filing portal exists and tax filings, registrations, and status certificates are submitted in paper form through the appointed RMI registered agent or directly at the Ministry in Majuro.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A non-resident Business Corporation is not issued a TIN or VAT registration number by the Marshall Islands. Step 1: Confirm that the entity is organized as a non-resident domestic corporation under the RMI Business Corporations Act and has no local trade or business. Step 2: Obtain a Certificate of Non-Resident Domestic Corporation Status, together with a Certificate of Good Standing, from the RMI Registrar of Corporations. Step 3: If the entity later ceases to be tax-exempt by commencing business within the Marshall Islands, register for gross revenue tax with the Revenue and Taxation Division; no VAT or GST registration is possible because no such tax exists. Step 4: For physical shipments through RMI customs, obtain an importer/exporter code from RMI Customs at the port of entry; otherwise no tax registration is required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: The Marshall Islands has no check-the-box, entity-classification election, or hybrid mismatch election. Tax treatment is fixed by the non-resident domestic corporation status under the RMI Business Corporations Act. An entity may elect to become a resident domestic corporation by amending its articles and thereby prospectively lose the tax-exempt zone treatment, but this is a corporate status election, not a separate tax election mechanism.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Gross Revenue Tax and customs duties only; no VAT, GST, or sales-and-use tax
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: N/A — no VAT/GST threshold exists. A gross revenue tax registration obligation arises only when a person carries on a trade or business within the Marshall Islands; there is no materiality threshold for that obligation, but a non-resident domestic corporation's offshore sale of collectible trading cards does not create RMI taxable nexus.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. The Marshall Islands does not require mandatory electronic invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API-based government reporting, or digital stamping. A non-resident tax-exempt Business Corporation may use ordinary commercial invoices; statutory record-keeping under the Business Corporations Act remains applicable.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The Marshall Islands does not operate a VAT or GST system, so no export zero-rating claim exists. Export sales of collectible trading cards are outside the scope of RMI gross revenue tax where the seller is a non-resident domestic corporation, title to goods passes outside the RMI, and proceeds are received outside the RMI. The entity must maintain its non-resident status and retain documentary proof of offshore destination, delivery, and payment.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration or re-export declaration, to the extent goods are physically cleared through RMI Customs
Commercial invoice and detailed packing list
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Inward remittance certificate or bank payment records evidencing offshore settlement of the export sale
Certificate of Non-Resident Domestic Corporation Status and Certificate of Good Standing
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent claims of tax-exempt status, misdeclared exports, or false documentation may trigger reassessment of gross revenue tax, civil penalties generally up to 25% of the tax due plus monthly interest, customs seizure or forfeiture under RMI customs law, and criminal liability for forgery, false declaration, or fraud. The ordinary reassessment window is three years from the relevant due date, but no limitation period applies in cases of fraud or wilful misrepresentation. A certificate of exemption obtained by misrepresentation is void ab initio, and all avoided taxes, penalties, and interest become immediately payable.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: None exists. The Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) has no central bank and no foreign-exchange administration; the U.S. dollar is the sole legal tender under the Compact of Free Association, monetary policy is effectively set by the U.S. Federal Reserve, and banking licensing and prudential supervision are performed by the RMI Banking Commission under the Banking Act 2005 (as amended).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The RMI maintains no exchange-control regime. Because the U.S. dollar is the domestic currency, both capital-account and current-account transactions are fully convertible, with no statutory exchange-approval permits, no restrictions on 100% non-resident equity ownership, and no withholding-type barriers on profit distributions or dividend remittances for a non-resident Business Corporation. The only practical frictions arise from the RMI's FATF grey-listing (as publicly reported since June 2024), which induces correspondent banks to apply enhanced due diligence to USD flows referencing RMI-licensed entities.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. RMI statute imposes no surrender requirement, no mandatory repatriation timeline, and no fixed conversion ratio for export receipts. All proceeds from collectible trading card sales are freely receivable, retainable, and disposable in USD, subject only to ordinary anti-money-laundering and sanctions screening by receiving financial institutions.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of the Marshall Islands (BOMI), Majuro
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational USD Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Guam - RMI Branch, Majuro and Ebeye

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium feasibility with defined legal limits. The RMI has no licensing or authorization framework for electronic money institutions, so an offshore EMI (e.g., Wise, Airwallex, Mercury, Brex) may be used only where the EMI is duly licensed in its home jurisdiction (US, UK, HK, or SG) and accepts an RMI non-resident Business Corporation as a client; grey-list-driven enhanced due diligence makes acceptance uncertain and slower than average. The target payment rails, Stripe and Authorize.Net, are card-acquiring and processing networks rather than clearing banks, so a separate commercial bank or EMI account with USD settlement capability remains mandatory.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors and ultimate beneficial owners are not required to travel to Majuro for company formation because the statutory registered office and registered agent are maintained locally by a licensed corporate service provider. However, for account opening, RMI-licensed banks and their US correspondents generally require at least a live video interview of each authorized signatory and UBO, and frequently insist on an in-person visit for high-balance capital escrow accounts. Remote opening is permitted only when combined with notarized and, where applicable, apostilled corporate documents, audited source-of-funds evidence, and a verifiable operating address outside the RMI.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: FATF grey-list jurisdiction designation (June 2024 onwards) triggering automatic correspondent-bank de-risking and default decline of RMI-related USD clearing
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Defense bundle: (i) Certificate of Good Standing and Certificate of Compliance issued by the RMI Registrar of Corporations; (ii) certified Articles of Incorporation, Bylaws, and board resolutions bearing the corporate seal; (iii) beneficial ownership register filing receipt and UBO declaration from the RMI transparency register; (iv) audited or reviewed financial statements covering the two most recent fiscal years or, for a newly formed entity, an opening-capital certification; (v) licensed registered agent's compliance opinion letter confirming extended due diligence already performed on all directors and UBOs; (vi) evidence of economic substance, including signed merchant agreements with Stripe and Authorize.Net, publishing or supply contracts, and a treasury-flow narrative; (vii) OFAC/UN sanctions-screening results for all relevant parties; and (viii), where flagged, an independent AML-audit certificate evidencing remediation measures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore shell-company suspicion: non-resident Business Corporation with no payroll, no premises, and no visible economic activity inside the RMI
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Defense bundle: (i) executed lease or management-service agreement for the operating office actually conducting management functions outside the RMI; (ii) corporate and UBO chain chart showing full ownership and control; (iii) originator bank reference letters covering the shareholders' funding history for the prior three months; (iv) notarized board resolution appointing signatories and authorizing account opening; (v) commercial documentation evidencing the ISIC 3240 activity (trading card design and printing contracts, holographic cold-foil specification sheets, licensee agreements, and gateway payout statements); and (vi) current certified passports of directors and UBOs with address verification, apostilled or notarized as applicable.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-funds opacity on inbound equity injection and elevated e-commerce chargeback risk for card-not-present collectible card sales
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Defense bundle: (i) SWIFT MT103 or cover-payment trail from the remitting bank demonstrating the origin and economic rationale of the capital injection; (ii) executed share-subscription agreement or contribution resolution citing the RMI Business Corporations Act; (iii) treasury model covering float, settlement lead time, refunds, and chargeback reserves; (iv) PCI DSS Level 1 attestation and a clean-merchant confirmation letter from Stripe or Authorize.Net; (v) negative sanctions-screening reports for all directors and UBOs; and (vi) an independent due-diligence report (World-Check or Dow Jones) confirming a low-risk profile for the UBO.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Because the RMI imposes no capital controls and maintains no RTGS system, capital injections are routed in USD via SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's remitting bank through US clearing channels (Fedwire or CHIPS) into the BC's offshore or BOMI account. The payment narrative must state 'equity capital contribution under the RMI Business Corporations Act', and when the receiving or intermediary bank requires a standardized classification, the IMF BPM6 direct-investment equity category (equity instruments) is used. No RMI governmental approval, exchange permit, or registration is required; the receiving bank performs only UBO verification, sanctions screening, and source-of-funds checks before crediting.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade disbursements run over three rails: (i) direct USD SWIFT MT103 wires for supplier invoices (specialty paper, holographic foil, inks, packaging) cleared through CHIPS or Fedwire; (ii) commercial letters of credit (MT700/MT707, or standby MT760) issued by the account bank in favor of machinery vendors supplying security holographic cold-foil printing equipment, payable against presentation of transport and inspection documents; and (iii) merchant settlement from Stripe and Authorize.Net, which clears card receivables in USD into the BC's pooled settlement account, with treasury concentration rules to manage settlement timing gaps. The RMI has no domestic clearing house, so all liquidity ultimately clears through US correspondent banking networks and the global payment platforms of the participating banks.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable outright FX forwards on major pairs (e.g., EUR/USD, GBP/USD, JPY/USD, AUD/USD)
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for emerging-market currency exposures arising from Asian print and substrate suppliers and royalty flows (e.g., CNY, KRW, INR, IDR, PHP, TWD)
FX swaps and cross-currency interest-rate swaps (XCS) to hedge USD-versus-EUR or USD-versus-JPY mismatches on machinery financing and long-term licensing obligations

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary date of incorporation each year; no statutory grace period and late penalty accrues immediately after the anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalties accrue from day 1 of delinquency; after 90 days' non-filing the Registrar may administratively strike the corporation off the register without further notice; reinstatement requires payment of all outstanding fees, penalties, and a registration reinstatement fee; a struck-off corporation loses juridical capacity to transact or litigate

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations through the licensed Registered Agent (confidential electronic UBO registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed concurrently with the Annual Report on each incorporation anniversary; any share transfer or UBO change must additionally be filed within 14 days of the event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Knowingly filing false UBO information is a criminal offence under the RMI AML/CFT regime punishable by a fine of up to US$10,000 and/or imprisonment for up to 2 years; agent non-compliance results in regulatory sanctions against the agent and may qualify as a ground for the Registrar's administrative strike-off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent and Registered Office Continuous Maintenance (AML/KYC Annual Refresh)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Marshall Islands Registered Agent (renewal documentation not filed publicly)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Continuous statutory obligation; agent's annual KYC and due-diligence refresh is typically completed 30 days before the anniversary and is a condition precedent to agent renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain the statutory registered agent and office in the Marshall Islands triggers default status and administrative strike-off; agent resignation without a qualified replacement within 30 days results in involuntary dissolution proceedings by the Registrar

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory audit exists for a non-resident Business Corporation under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act; financial statements and auditor's reports are not lodged with the Registrar. A statutory audit becomes mandatory only if (i) shareholders by majority resolution at the annual meeting require it, (ii) the company lists securities on a recognized stock exchange, (iii) secured creditors representing not less than 25% of outstanding indebtedness request an independent examination, or (iv) a court of competent jurisdiction orders an audit upon a shareholder's application
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No local statutory accounting framework applies to non-resident exempt corporations; IFRS as issued by the IASB or US GAAP may be adopted at the board's election; books of account must be kept and be adequate to explain transactions and financial position with reasonable accuracy

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent maintains the confidential beneficial ownership register on the Registrar's e-registry; every share transfer or change in beneficial ownership must be confirmed with the agent and filed within 14 days; the Annual Report contains a UBO certification confirming the schedule as of the anniversary date, and a fresh beneficial ownership confirmation is executed at each share transfer and annually at renewal
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of Shareholders, Directors, and Officers

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$6,000–US$18,000 if a voluntary independent audit is engaged; compilation-only financial statements US$2,500–US$6,000; not a statutory obligation for non-resident BCs

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no payroll tax on non-resident employees, and no value added tax. Non-resident business corporations are subject only to annual registration and renewal compliance fees.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No income tax return is required. Annual Corporation Renewal Filing through the Marshall Islands Registrar of Corporations online portal (MI Registrar) is mandatory to maintain good standing.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The renewal filing and fee are due by the corporation’s registration anniversary date in each calendar year, as specified in the Articles of Incorporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name of the business corporation as registered.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the English legal name exactly as it appears on the Certificate of Incorporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Unique number assigned by the Marshall Islands Registrar.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the entity's MH corporate file number; verify against the original charter.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name of the registered agent in the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident corporations should confirm the registered agent is current and accepts annual notice processing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Street address of the registered agent in Majuro or Ebeye.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide only the statutory registered address; place of business may be offshore.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: A short description of the corporation's actual business purpose.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For ISIC 3240, clearly state 'publishing, printing, and distribution of collectible trading cards' to match declared commercial scope.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names and addresses of current directors and officers.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: List all directors; the Business Corporations Act requires at least one director; non-resident directors are permissible.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of issued shares and total par value, if any.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose authorized, issued, and outstanding shares accurately; there is no minimum capital requirement.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box H - Declaration of Non-Resident Status
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that the corporation's income is sourced outside the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Mark the non-resident income declaration where applicable to affirm no Marshall Islands source income is generated.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file the annual renewal and pay the prescribed fee leads to administrative dissolution, a reinstatement penalty, and the loss of the corporation's power to assert legal rights in Marshall Islands courts. Centralized certificates of good standing are withheld until all arrears are paid.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% (Marshall Islands imposes no dividend withholding tax)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable because Marshall Islands does not levy withholding tax on dividends and has no comprehensive double tax agreements for income tax. No tax residency certificate or treaty relief application is necessary for a non-resident shareholder receiving dividends from a Marshall Islands business corporation.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory rate for both royalties and interest on cross-border payments; no treaty reduction is required because no source-country tax is imposed.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable - Marshall Islands has no statutory transfer pricing regime, no local file or master file duty, and no documentation threshold in U.S. dollars or any other currency.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Marshall Islands law does not codify an economic substance regulations (ESR) framework for plain trading card publishing corporations. The entity must still avoid a purely passive or sham structure in practice so that payment processors, banks, and foreign tax authorities respect the separate legal personality of the non-resident business corporation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Fraudulent Cross-Border Arrangements
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Misrepresenting the location of trading card sales or using the Marshall Islands entity to disguise income taxable in a high-tax jurisdiction while failing to disclose the true interdependencies.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Revocation of business authorization by the Registrar, monetary administrative penalties under applicable revenue enforcement law, and criminal prosecution for fraudulent documentary conduct.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors deliberately participating in a sham profit-stripping scheme may face civil restitution of evaded fiscal claims, personal asset seizures, and imprisonment for fraud if the entity is used as a mere façade.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company Abuse Without Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a phantom board, having no office or governing records, and allowing undisclosed third parties to funnel trading card receivables through the corporation's payment rails.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative dissolution by the Marshall Islands Registrar; enabling orders under the RMI Business Corporations Act to lift limited liability protection.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who abdicate all authority may be jointly and severally liable for corporate obligations of collectible trading card ventures, face director-ban orders, and be subjected to travel restrictions during investigative proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Anti-Money Laundering and Beneficial Ownership Violations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to maintain an accurate register of beneficial owners, using nominee shareholders to conceal the true controller of the trading card publishing company, or accepting payments from sanctioned entities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Monetary penalties up to $25,000 per violation under the Marshall Islands Beneficial Ownership Regulations and the RMI Anti-Money Laundering framework; potential freezing of bank and escrow accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors knowingly enabling beneficial ownership concealment face direct criminal fines, personal civil liability to third-party creditors, and imprisonment for money-laundering offenses.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Payment Processor and Payment Rails Misrepresentation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Submitting applications to Stripe, Authorize.Net, or other payment processors with false details about beneficial ownership, operating jurisdiction, or the commercial model while selling collectible trading cards to consumers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Instant account termination, seizure of settlement reserves, contractual indemnification claims, and referral to law enforcement for wire fraud.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Executive officers who approve falsified payment integration statements may be held personally liable for proceeds-derived damages, receive international travel bans in cross-border fraud inquiries, and face custodial criminal sentences.
